$comment: Single source of truth for the realtime invalidation vocabulary.
A resource names WHAT went stale, never WHY. Four tables mirror this file:
Each of those has a parity test against this file, so a resource cannot be
published without every consumer knowing what to drop, and a consumer
cannot keep a rule for a resource nobody publishes.
Adding a resource: add it here first, then run the four parity tests and
fix what they report. Bump `version` on any breaking payload change.

tournament.detail.doc: The tournament read model: layout, metadata, live participants_count/registrations_count.

tournament.encounters.doc: Encounter list and any single encounter's score/state.

tournament.standings.doc: Standings, including the matches_history they embed.

tournament.teams.doc: Materialized tournament.team / player rows (balancer or draft export).

tournament.structure.doc: The set of sections a tournament page has (stages created/removed, teams first materialized). The only resource that also forces a route-level refresh on the client.

tournament.registrations.doc: Public participants list and per-registration admin rows.

tournament.registration_form.doc: Registration form configuration (admin-owned). Cached nowhere server-side; clients hold it in a query.

tournament.streams.doc: Which channels are live for the tournament.

workspace.pickup_mix.doc: Pickup-mix rosters, ranks, config, host and status.

workspace.subscriptions.doc: Subscription entitlements for the workspace's members.

workspace.analytics_jobs.doc: Analytics job list and their statuses.
